items.title: Matters.AI Lands India’s Largest Cybersecurity Pre-Series A Round to Fight AI Data Risks
items.description: The security startup consolidates four legacy security tools into an autonomous platform that uses context-aware AI to trace sensitive data lineage, analyze user intent, and automatically remediate threats across enterprise environments.

items.title: US Air Force cloud platform reportedly hacked in latest federal breach
items.description: Hackers have reportedly breached the US Air Force's Cloud One computing platform, adding to a recent wave of cyberattacks affecting US government agencies, including the FBI, CIA, and Treasury Department. [...]

items.title: Your Firewall Isn't Enough: The Hidden Risk of Unmanaged VMs
items.description: Forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and excessive access permissions can create security blind spots across IT infrastructure. ISPsystem explains how centralized infrastructure management, access controls, and resource lifecycle automation can help reduce these risks. [...]

items.title: 'God Mode' Flaws Could Wreak Border-Control Havoc
items.description: Attackers could have disrupted traveler entry into Nigeria, Ethiopia, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Fiji, and Ghana via several vulnerabilities in their online visa and immigration systems.

items.title: Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach
items.description: A vulnerability in hex.pm allowed hackers to run commands on web servers. No evidence of data modification was found, but database reads are not logged. The post Hex Package Manager Warns of Potential Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
items.description: SAP has detected suspicious activity on GitHub, where hackers reportedly used stolen employee tokens to copy and alter source code. The post SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
items.description: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday.
